verdict.rationale: First-party docs direct developers to official SDKs for data ingestion ('use an SDK or the Pipelines API'). They describe a mobile SDK for identifying people and sending push, rich push, and in-app messages, and an official JavaScript client snippet. A published OpenAPI spec for the Track, App, and Design Studio APIs adds a machine-readable base to build against. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported SDK languages/platforms, depth on server-side SDKs, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
